groups.note: E2 は宗教指導者の例から孔子（공자）を落としている（イエス・釈迦・ムハンマドだけ）
diff: The Korean original names Confucius, Jesus, Shakyamuni and Mohammed (English edition: “Jesus, Buddha, or the Prophet Mohammed”).

en.ko: 혼자 훌륭한 이상을 꿈꾼들 이룰 수 있는 것은 아무것도 없습니다.

groups.note: 一人で立派な理想を夢見ても何も成し遂げられない、を英語は省いている
E26・E27 は「김밥（のり巻き）」を「homemade snacks」としている
食い違い: E33 は7年を「public good のために生きた時間」とする（韓国語は「本当に自分のために生きたと言える時間」）
diff: The Korean original says those seven years are the only time one can truly say one lived for oneself (English edition: “living for the public good”).

groups.note: 食い違い: E35 は「7일（7日）」を「seven years」とする（韓国語は同じ7年が、ある人には7日、ある人には70年ほどに使われる）
diff: The Korean original says the same seven years may be used like seven days by one person and like seventy years by another (English edition: “spent as seven years or as seventy”).

groups.note: 食い違い: E42 も7年を「public good のために生きた」とする（韓国語は「自分のために生きた7年」）
diff: The Korean original says only the seven years a person lived for himself remain and are remembered by later generations (English edition: “the seven years that he lived for the public good”).

groups.note: 食い違い: E62 は「우리에게 주어진 7년（与えられた7年）」を「those eighty years」とする
diff: The Korean original says the seven years given to us (English edition: “those eighty years that are given to us”).

groups.note: E93・E94 は「무덤（墓）」を「legacy」に置き換え、墓の中に何を入れるかという比喩を消している
diff: The Korean original says that when a person dies only the grave remains, and asks what must be put into that grave for one to say one lived a life of value (English edition: “only his legacy remains,” “what you can do to show that you lived a life of value”).

groups.note: E99 は「사랑의 무덤（愛の墓）」を「legacy of love」としている
diff: The Korean original says love is all that remains in the grave, and that we must live so as to leave behind a grave of love (English edition: “a legacy of love”).
